title: ToolService.entry
description: Builds each tool's catalog entry from its `tools` row and its active loan, with its status from `toolStatus`, on each request: for every tool in `ToolService.list` and for the tool each tool command returns. The catalog is never stored.

title: measureOutcomes
description: Reads every loan and each tool's `added_at` from the store, and the `DamageReported` and `ToolRepaired` events in the outbox to tell whether a tool needed repair when a loan opened. It counts the measures on each run of the report and stores nothing.
